personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK with 7 Dark-First Utility layout for data density
personality_one_liner: Premium fintech-level polish delivering high-contrast, data-dense CRM utility within a luxurious, dark-themed visual environment.

spacing.rule: Generous outer padding to frame the app like a premium display, but compact spacing inside inventory cards/grids to maximize CRM data density.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar, floating actions, sticky headers, and hero card overlays placed on top of property images.
Ensure a >75% opacity dark tint under the blur to maintain AAA readability for CRM data.
dont's: Do not blur dense inventory grid cells or form inputs.
Do not use glassmorphism on standard body content.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level KPI overview (leads, bookings, revenue) acting as a command center for the active role.

states.loading: Skeleton UI over surfaceSecondary metric blocks.
states.empty: AI-generated illustration of a sleek abstract structure, with a prompt to add the first lead.
states.error: Muted error message with a 'Retry Sync' primary CTA.

screens.layout: Top section for role/profile switch. Middle section composed of bold metric cards (using brand accent colors minimally) arranged in a 2-column grid. Bottom section for 'Recent Activities' timeline.

screens.name: Leads Pipeline
screens.purpose: Kanban-style board and timeline view tracking lead progression from New to Closed.

states.loading: Skeleton cards cascading down the pipeline columns.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty calendar/board. Text: 'No leads in this stage yet.'
states.error: Text stating 'Could not load leads' with a reload button.

screens.layout: Sticky horizontal scroll at the top for pipeline stages. Below, a vertical scrolling list of compact lead cards showing name, AI score badge, and quick-action icon.

screens.name: Inventory Grid
screens.purpose: A dense, highly visual matrix of property units reflecting their current booking status.

states.loading: Grid of surfaceTertiary skeleton squares flashing softly.
states.empty: Icon of an empty building grid with 'No units match your filter.'

screens.layout: Top sticky header with filter chips (N/S/E/W, Floor, Tower). The core is a responsive multi-column grid (3-col or 4-col depending on size) where each cell uses a status-colored dot (success=available, warning=reserved, error=sold, info=blocked) over a dark surfaceSecondary card.

screens.name: AI CRM Assistant
screens.purpose: Chat interface powered by Claude for instant property recommendations and lead scoring explanations.

states.loading: Pulsing brand logo indicating AI is 'thinking'.
states.empty: Greeting message with suggested prompt chips (e.g., 'Analyze lead X').
states.error: Message bubble failing to send with a red exclamation.

screens.layout: Full screen chat flow. User messages in surfaceTertiary bubbles, AI messages in surfaceSecondary bubbles. Input field sticky at bottom above keyboard.

hero_property_exterior.alt: Tall modern luxury real estate apartment building with a dark, dramatic backdrop.

hero_property_interior.alt: A sleek and modern apartment living room interior featuring dark cabinetry and premium ambient lighting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme mapping provided. Do not use generic whites or blues, rely solely on the hex codes extracted from the problem statement.
Inventory status colors (success=Green, warning=Yellow, error=Red, info=Grey) must strictly align with the exact use cases: Available, Reserved, Sold/Booked, Blocked.
Typography requires 'SpaceGrotesk-Medium' for headings to enforce the fintech-level, high-contrast, editorial feel.
Implement the Inventory grid as a highly visual, responsive 3 or 4-column matrix with dense information layout.
Use skeleton loaders for data screens (dashboard, inventory, leads) and avoid spinning loaders.
Always apply a gradient-to-dark scrim layer when rendering text over the luxury property images to guarantee readability.
Ensure 'brandTertiary' (Premium Orange #FF7A1A) is used extremely sparingly, only for premium accents or critical AI-driven insights.
